verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs describe it as a self-hosted gateway that runs as one Gateway process on your own machine. Install paths include an installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, building from source, and optional Docker. Docs also cover remote access via Tailscale or SSH, multi-tenant hosted cells, and an open-source GitHub repo. Community users independently report running it on their own machines and in a NixOS QEMU VM with local models, which corroborates the self-hosting claim.
